result.finding: The Asset Manager application has 3 external runtime dependencies: PostgreSQL (relational database), RabbitMQ (message broker), and AWS S3 (object storage). Additionally, it requires JDK 8 and Maven 3.6.0+ as build/runtime prerequisites. No authentication services (LDAP, OAuth), caching layers (Redis), or search engines (Elasticsearch) are used.
evidence: worker/application.properties: same PostgreSQL JDBC connection string
web/AwsS3Config.java: S3Client.builder() using aws.accessKey, aws.secretKey, aws.region (AWS S3)
worker/AwsS3Config.java: S3Client.builder() for worker module (AWS S3)
values: PostgreSQL: relational database for image metadata (port 5432, DB: assets_manager)
RabbitMQ: AMQP message broker for async image processing (port 5672, management UI: 15672)
AWS S3: object storage for image files (SDK: software.amazon.awssdk:s3 v2.25.13)
Docker: infrastructure prerequisite for local development
